name: Biak Pacific Half Marathon 2026
short_description: Biak Pacific Half Marathon 2026 is on Saturday 21 November 2026 on Biak island, Papua, with a 21.1 km half marathon along the Bosnik shoreline, a 10 km and a 5 km.
ai_summary: The Biak Pacific Half Marathon 2026 is a sport-tourism road race on Biak island in Biak Numfor regency, Papua, on Saturday 21 November 2026. The organiser describes a half-marathon course that starts at sunrise on flat tarmac along the Bosnik shoreline, heads inland under palms through villages and finishes along the sea wall. It offers 21.0975 km, 10 km and 5 km races, with fees of IDR 229,000 to 399,000 on TokoTix, and is managed by Anoa Race Management.

core_facts.venue: Biak Kota district (course along the Bosnik shoreline)

faqs.question: When is the Biak Pacific Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Saturday 21 November 2026, a Saturday rather than a Sunday, according to the TokoTix entry page. The event is based in the Biak Kota district of Biak Numfor regency, Papua. Start times had not been published, but the organiser says the half marathon begins at sunrise on the Bosnik shoreline.

faqs.question: What distances does the Biak race offer and what do they cost?
faqs.answer: Three distances: the full 21.0975 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km. On TokoTix the half marathon costs IDR 399,000, the 10 km IDR 319,000 and the 5 km IDR 229,000. Tickets are limited to one per person, and runners must give their ID card details and jersey size when entering.

faqs.question: What is the course like?
faqs.answer: The organiser describes flat tarmac beside the reef along the Bosnik coast at sunrise, then a section inland under palm trees through villages, before a finish along the sea wall. A detailed route map had not been published. Biak is an island off the north coast of Papua, served by Frans Kaisiepo Airport.
